Mod.Name: [Cronos Team] Uncensored
Mod.Author: Cronos Team
Mod.Description:
► Undo the game's censorship ◄
Undo the censorship applied to some versions of the game, mainly the European ones. All options are On by default.
◆ Censorship fixes ◆ • GerogeroUncensoredCard: Restore Gerogero's uncensored card texture. • GerogeroUncensoredBattle: Restore Gerogero's uncensored battle textures. • SelphieScanTilt: Allow tilting Selphie's model in the Scan viewer, like every other model. • ArmoryRedBlood: Restore the Japanese red blood in Ultimecia Castle's Armory (green outside Japan). • RedArmband: Restore the red armbands of General Caraway and the D-District Prison warden (blue outside Japan).

LatestVersion.ReleaseNotes: • 1.0 Split from FF8 Gameplay Customizer 0.8: GerogeroUncensoredCard, GerogeroUncensoredBattle, SelphieScanTilt, ArmoryRedBlood and RedArmband. Gerogero battle ships only the language-independent FFNx textures.
